rows.disclaimer: A planning tool built from numbers you entered. Not financial, tax or legal advice.
rows.how_it_works: Each component has one measured value, a best level and a worst level. The fraction is clamped between 0 and 1. Financial points = fraction x weight; risk points = (1 - fraction) x weight. A score is points divided by the weight of components that have data, times 100. A component without data is a Needs and is left out. Under the minimum weight coverage no number is shown.

reweight.range_low: every Needs component scores the worst case
reweight.range_high: every Needs component scores full marks
reweight.below_min: Show 'Not enough data' instead of a number

trend.note: No trend arrow until enough monthly snapshots exist.

inputs.liquid_excludes: Set liquid_asset_ids to the cash accounts you can spend. Leave out retirement, HSA, tax refunds not yet received, home and vehicle.
inputs.runway_excluded_note: Bills listed in runway_excluded_bill_ids are left out of the runway only; they stay in every other total.
inputs.secondary_without_foreign: Secondary labeled figure only: surplus and runway without the bills in foreign_bill_ids

components.name: Debt to income
components.formula: (payments of every debt in the ratio, with cards that have no minimum counted at 4% of balance) / base gross monthly pay x 100
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.

components.name: High interest debt burden
components.formula: sum of balances with APR above 10% / annual gross pay x 100. Shown beside it: the same balance divided by liquid cash.
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.

components.name: Emergency fund (cash runway, must-pay)
components.formula: liquid cash / monthly must-pay outflow. Must-pay = essential bills + every debt payment + amounts withheld from pay.
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.

components.name: Savings rate from payroll
components.formula: (401(k) you + HSA you + HSA employer + 401(k) employer, per year) / annual gross x 100
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.

components.name: Retirement pace vs goal (401(k) saving only)
components.formula: balance at retirement age = B x (1+r)^n + C x ((1+r)^n - 1)/r, with B = retirement balance, C = yearly 401(k) saving now, r = base real return, n = target age - current age; divided by goal_low x 100
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.

components.name: Monthly cash flow surplus
components.formula: (take-home - bills - debt payments not already withheld) / take-home x 100
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.
requires: bank and card statements covering at least 60 days
components.needs: Bank and card statements (about 2 months) so spending is measured, not estimated

components.name: Net worth vs age benchmark
components.formula: retirement balance / salary compared with an age benchmark table
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.
components.needs: A sourced age benchmark row for your age

components.name: Credit utilization
components.formula: sum of open card balances / sum of open card limits x 100 (a closed account has type Closed credit card and is skipped)
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.
requires: liabilities.credit_limit for every open card (closed accounts excluded)
components.needs: Credit limit for every open card

components.name: Insurance and protection
components.formula: items confirmed in place / items in checklist (health, auto, home, term life, disability, umbrella)
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.
components.needs: Which of life, disability, umbrella, home and health coverage you have, with amounts

components.name: Single income earner
components.formula: largest earner's gross / household gross x 100
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.

components.name: Liquidity runway (all fixed costs)
components.formula: liquid cash / (all bills + all debt payments + amounts withheld from pay)
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.

components.name: Debt rate sensitivity
components.formula: (variable rate balances x 2 percentage points) / annual take-home x 100
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.
components.needs: Whether each variable-looking loan has a fixed or variable rate

components.name: Combined loan to value
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.

components.name: Total debt to total assets
components.formula: all debt balances / all assets in net worth x 100
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.

components.name: Tax exposure
components.formula: open tax balances / liquid cash x 100. Interest and penalties are not in the balance, so this understates.
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.
optional_needs: Any notice or payment plan letter

components.name: One-time planned cost
components.formula: monthly amount of the bills listed in foreign_bill_ids (a planned or unusual cost you name) / monthly take-home x 100.
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.
optional_needs: Which bills are the planned cost

components.name: Data completeness
components.formula: data_queue items still needed (status Needed or Statement requested) / (still needed + Provided) x 100
components.source: Design choice. The best and worst levels can be changed in this file.
